app.title: WebcamCCTV
app.subtitle: Private, local-first camera monitoring
language.label: Language
setup.title: Welcome to WebcamCCTV
setup.notice: Before continuing, comply with all applicable privacy, surveillance, workplace, audio-recording, and consent laws. WebcamCCTV does not hide camera activity or bypass operating-system privacy indicators.
setup.choose_language: Choose the interface language. You can change it later in Settings.
settings.subtitle: Capture, storage, and interface preferences
settings.saved: Settings were saved safely to {path}. Restart the surveillance service to apply capture changes.
service.subtitle: Monitor health and control background capture
service.already_running: The surveillance service is already running.
service.startup_race: Another surveillance service instance started at the same time.
camera.preview_hint: The local preview pauses automatically while the background service owns the camera.
camera.unavailable: Camera is unavailable or being used by another application.
recording.encoder_error: The video encoder could not be opened.
recordings.subtitle: Search the latest locally stored events
tray.started_body: The background surveillance service was started.
validation.mode: Recording mode must be continuous, motion detection, or manual.
validation.fps: Camera frame rate must be between 1 and 120.
validation.sensitivity: Motion sensitivity must be between 0 and 1.
validation.motion_area: Minimum motion area must be positive.
validation.segment: Segment duration must be at least 5 seconds.
installer.unsupported: This operating system is not supported: {system}
validation.language: Interface language must be a supported language.
validation.theme: Appearance must be system, dark, or light.
validation.notification_language: Notification language must be a supported language.
validation.camera_device: Camera device must be a non-negative integer.
validation.camera_id: Camera ID must be between 1 and 64 characters.
validation.multiple_cameras: This release supports one active camera per service.
validation.polygons: Motion zones and privacy masks must contain normalized polygons with at least three points.
validation.camera_controls: Camera controls must use valid OpenCV property names and numeric values.
validation.audio_unsupported: Audio recording is not implemented in this release and cannot be enabled.
validation.audio_rate: The selected audio sample rate is unsupported.
validation.audio_channels: Audio channels must be one or two.
validation.schedule_weekdays: Schedule weekdays must be unique integers from 0 through 6.
validation.schedule_time: Schedule times must use 24-hour HH:MM format.
validation.lock_detection_unsupported: Screen-lock detection is not implemented in this release.
validation.remote_loopback: The remote API may bind only to loopback.
validation.remote_unsupported: The remote API is not implemented in this release and cannot be enabled.
validation.notifications_unsupported: System notifications are not implemented in this release and cannot be enabled.
validation.encryption_unsupported: Automatic recording encryption is not implemented in this release and cannot be enabled.
validation.ai_unsupported: AI event detection is not implemented in this release and cannot be enabled.
validation.encoder: The selected video encoder is unsupported.
validation.motion_timing: Motion pre-event, post-event, and cooldown durations cannot be negative.
validation.sync_path: The synchronization directory must be outside the recording directory.
validation.preview_fps: Preview frame rate must be between 1 and 60.
service.not_running: The surveillance service is not running.
service.start_failed: The surveillance service exited before startup completed.
service.start_timeout: The surveillance service did not confirm startup in time.
service.stop_timeout: The surveillance service did not stop before the timeout.
recording.manual_mode_required: Manual recording commands require manual recording mode.
recording.stop_hint: Stop and finalize the current manual recording
recording.control_requires_service: Start the surveillance service before using manual recording controls.
recording.control_requires_restart: Save Manual recording mode and restart the surveillance service to apply it.
camera.preview_paused: Preview is paused while the background service uses the camera.
validation.date_time_format: The date and time format must be a string.
validation.camera_name: Camera name must be between 1 and 120 characters.
validation.boolean: Configuration switches must use true or false values.
validation.camera_disabled: The active camera cannot be disabled.
validation.motion_disabled: Motion detection must be enabled when motion recording mode is selected.
